description: This file defines a Java interface 'JsonObject' that represents an immutable JSON object with various methods for creation, manipulation, and retrieval of JSON data. It includes static factory methods for creating instances from strings or building new objects, and instance methods for setting, getting, removing fields, and querying the object. The interface supports complex operations like retrieving subgraphs, using pointers and selectors, and handling typed values with generics.

classes.name: JsonObject
classes.description: An interface representing an immutable JSON object with methods for creation, viewing, and modification of JSON data. Supports deep retrieval, setting, removal, and querying of fields, leveraging JSON pointers and selectors for complex operations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a JsonObject from a JSON string representation.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder for constructing or modifying JsonObject instances.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Provides an immutable empty JsonObject instance.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder pre-initialized with the current object's data for modifications.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Creates a new JsonObject with a specified field key and value, replacing existing if present.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a field according to a field definition and value, producing a new JsonObject.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Adds a field to the object, replacing any previous with the same key.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Adds or replaces multiple fields from an iterable collection.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a field exists at a given key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a sub-object by JSON pointer, returning a new JsonObject.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a sub-object using a JsonFieldDefinition.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a subset of the object based on a JsonFieldSelector.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Gets an optional JSON value at the specified key.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Gets a typed Java value at a location defined by a JsonFieldDefinition, wrapped in an Optional.

methods.name: getValueOrThrow
methods.description: Gets a typed Java value at a location defined by a JsonFieldDefinition or throws if missing or mismatched type.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Returns a new JsonObject without the specified key or path.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of all keys in document order.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Gets the JsonField which contains key and value, wrapped in Optional.
